spec.title: Citation inspection
spec.outcome: Viewers can read the cited transcript and use the citation modal with the keyboard.

acceptance.text: Opening a video citation displays its supplied transcript snippet alongside the video player.
A multiline transcript snippet remains readable with its line breaks preserved.
Opening the citation modal moves keyboard focus to a usable control inside it.
Closing the citation modal returns keyboard focus to the opener when it remains in the document.

constraints: Preserve existing video playback, timestamp links, Escape, close-button and backdrop close behavior.
Preserve authentication, owner-private conversations and the 25 messages per user per 24 hours limit.
All existing independent proof and permission rules remain mandatory.
non_goals: No new content sources, sharing, auth changes, factory authority changes or external dependencies.
